privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This policy explains how ZAN Global Investments handles personal data submitted by visitors through the website's contact form, why it is used, and the rights associated with it.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: When you use the contact form, we may collect your name, email address, inquiry type, and message. You may optionally provide your organization or company name and phone number. Required fields allow the company to review and respond to your inquiry.

sections.title: 2. Why We Use Your Data
sections.body: We use submitted information to review inquiries and requests relating to investment, partnerships, and collaboration; respond to the person making the inquiry; and follow up on related correspondence. The form is not designed to collect sensitive data, and we do not use its submissions to send unrelated marketing messages.

sections.title: 3. Processing and Disclosure
sections.body: The website uses Web3Forms to transmit contact-form submissions to the designated receiving email inbox. Web3Forms acts as a service provider for form processing, and data may be processed through its infrastructure and subprocessors. Its published privacy policy provides further information about its infrastructure and data handling. External services may also be used to load the website's fonts. We do not sell personal data.

sections.title: 4. Storage and Retention
sections.body: According to its published policy, Web3Forms retains form-submission data for up to three years, unless a shorter period applies to the plan or the data is deleted earlier. Email notification copies may remain in the receiving mailbox until deleted. The company retains correspondence for as long as reasonably necessary to respond to the inquiry and meet applicable legal obligations, after which it deletes or appropriately disposes of the data when it is no longer needed, subject to any legal retention requirements.

sections.title: 5. Security and Processing Locations
sections.body: We use external services to operate the contact form and load fonts. Those providers process data under their own policies and terms. Data may be processed or stored in locations outside Saudi Arabia. This policy does not specify the exact geographical location of provider servers, and using these services alone does not confirm that all requirements for international data transfers have been met. Relevant processing and protection arrangements must be reviewed before launch.

sections.title: 6. Your Rights
sections.body: Subject to applicable law, you may request information about how your data is processed, access your data, obtain a readable copy, request correction or completion, or request destruction where legal conditions are met. You may also withdraw consent where consent is the applicable legal basis. We may need to verify your identity before acting on a request. Requests will be handled within applicable statutory time limits, subject to any legally permitted extension.

sections.title: 7. Cookies and Third-Party Services
sections.body: The current website uses external services to load fonts and process contact-form submissions. This policy does not state that advertising or behavioral analytics tools are in use. If such tools are added later, we will review whether this policy and related notices need to be updated. Hosting and security providers may also maintain technical logs under their own configurations and policies.

sections.title: 8. Privacy Requests and Policy Updates
sections.body: To exercise your data rights or ask a question about this policy, contact the company through the website's contact form and explain the nature of your request. We will review this policy if the website's data collection, processing, or service providers change, and update the revision date when material changes are made.

privacyPage.closing: This policy describes the data processing associated with the website's current functionality. It does not replace the company's review of the data-protection requirements applicable to its activities.
